units.source_text: “我从猿乐町走到神保町大街，又拐向了小川町。

en.t: I walked from Sarugakucho to the main street of Jimbocho, then turned toward Ogawamachi.

units.source_text: 我到这一带来，一向是为了逛旧书店，可是那天，我却怎么也提不起劲头去看那些破旧的书了。

en.t: Whenever I came to this area, it was usually to browse the secondhand bookshops, but that day I simply could not work up any interest in looking at those worn old books.

units.source_text: 我一边走，一边不停地琢磨着家里发生的事情，

en.t: As I walked, I kept turning over in my mind what had happened at home,

units.source_text: 回想着刚才夫人的举止，猜想着小姐回家后的情景，仿佛这二者在催着我走路似的。

en.t: recalling the lady's behavior just now and imagining what would happen after the young lady returned home, as if those two things were driving my steps onward.

units.source_text: 我不自觉地停下来，呆呆地站在大街上，

en.t: Without realizing it, I stopped and stood blankly in the street,

units.source_text: 想着这会儿夫人大概正跟小姐谈那个事吧，

en.t: thinking that by now the lady was probably talking with the young lady about that matter,

units.source_text: 过了一会儿又想，现在差不多说完了。

en.t: and after a while I thought again that by now she must be nearly finished.

units.source_text: 就这样，我过了万世桥，走上明神坡路，来到本乡台，然后又走下菊坂路，最后回到了小石川低洼地。

en.t: In this way, I crossed Manseibashi, climbed the Myojin slope, reached Hongo-dai, then went down Kikuzaka, and finally returned to the low ground of Koishikawa.

units.source_text: 我走的距离，可以说横跨这三个区域，画了一个大大的椭圆形。

en.t: The distance I walked could be said to have spanned those three districts and traced a large oval.

units.source_text: 但是，在这么长距离的散步过程中，我几乎一次也没想到K。

en.t: But during that long walk, I almost never thought of K even once.

units.source_text: 现在回想起来，连我自己也不知是怎么回事，只觉得奇怪。

en.t: Looking back on it now, even I do not know what was going on, and can only find it strange.

units.source_text: 我之所以会把K忘掉，虽然也可以说是由于太紧张了，但也说明了我的良心无法宽恕自己。

en.t: The fact that I could forget K may be explained by saying that I was too tense, but it also shows that my conscience could not forgive me.
